evidence: PARTIAL local execution; required full configured verifier launch/grading is unmeasured. The frozen verifier Dockerfile is byte-identical to its template (SHA256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd). Lines 1-4 provide Node 22 and Python 3.12; lines 16-21 pin Claude Code 2.1.281, Playwright MCP 0.0.79, Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1; line 31 pins harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7; lines 33-38 install the MCP-bundled Chromium and expose /usr/local/bin/chromium. The reference package.json and agent Dockerfile use those same two runtime dependencies, consistent with integration.md. The restart MCP uses /usr/local/bin/python3 (functional judge.toml:17-18). No task-specific missing image dependency was found. Actual uncached task-layer build evidence, local/uncached-build/verifier.json, records exit 0 in 214.25 s and image sha256:69ff23b983822e2fcd9b11c7a9d9ea6b1b4b716dfd0fbaacac98886ed3235fe0. The corresponding verifier.log:305 records RewardKit installation; :953-965 records Chromium 152.0.7977.8 / revision 1237; :1009-1011 records image export. Verified indexed artifact SHA256 values: verifier.json=6d698bbaf5cd23a1574b716f41295ab73c83e14774d08477ff909495230f9d70; verifier.log=6495ea30e3054c4ff730e68d6ba74c14ae043a8b75e2312a060577cfab19b52e. The uncached image inspection successfully imports installed RewardKit, resolves all five configurations and reports Claude Code 2.1.281, MCP 0.0.79 and Node v22.23.2. All 15 tests_sha256 entries match the frozen task. However, local/inspect-configured.py:23 explicitly executes /usr/bin/true with the generated argument bytes instead of the configured judge. Its driver runs with --network none. This proves parser/schema/OS argument feasibility and CLI version launch, not model authentication, browser tool use by that judge, output serialization or complete grading. Verified hashes: local/inspect-configured.py=1bf27ef3d4efa0ef7be7d25fc113afad3066e6f038e9c97327a597ca455e70bf; local/uncached-inspection/configured-inspection/results.json=846bbc329dd21dae7950550587f858211460d50d6820ae5b459b52f38449b808; local/uncached-inspection/run.log=480a9660345c466ae1c3d7344433b2f429b3ce06928ca77ded1b2e097cd05037. Local MCP responses RPC 3-5 show browser navigation, a successful requisition creation and readback after separate-context sign-in. The driver launches the app directly on port 3032 and uses symlinked globally installed dependencies, so it is useful browser/runtime evidence but not the canonical unprivileged /tests/test.sh run. All 13 before/after application hashes match the frozen source. Verified hashes: local/mcp.cjs=91524d29b805eb616869c889fd1e5b7d5cabc5e8e84711c438a34730e0af90a6; local/mcp/results.json=48a0cd895038166f56e2e0998a00eccdcc671cd8842b4dca468f7b8df9c8013f; requests.jsonl=a47c870d86ccacdd9225d078e7ec32eee1a983dbc38c02faab9d1295c051c306; responses.jsonl=3afbf428923a63ccdace0988942246974e02c1b5e50341fc7cff5ac8e334c454. The current raw index explicitly has no full configured grade, and runtime-evidence.json is absent. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md Runtime and model evidence and qc/README.md Runtime evidence require a hash-bound full verifier launch/grading record for this row before local clearance. Therefore the full row cannot be Pass despite the positive provisioning evidence. No provider run, Oracle score, portal result or full-grade defect is asserted.
counterexample: Analytical challenge, not a measured score: a static Node HTTP shell that returns 200 for /api/health can pass image build, CLI-version and /usr/bin/true argument checks just as the conforming app does; none of those checks observes a product grade. The render criterion correctly says a health-only/static app is insufficient, but its actual configured judgment has not been run. Conversely a fully conforming Express/better-sqlite3 implementation can pass these local image checks and still receive the initial zero if the configured provider/CLI path fails: test.sh:207-209 runs RewardKit and :213-215 exits on its nonzero status. Provider-authentication or transport failure is a concrete example of that unmeasured path, not an observed current failure. No image dependency mismatch against a conforming alternative was found.
suggested_fix: When provider execution is authorized, run the frozen candidate through the unchanged canonical test.sh with its configured judge/model, retain app launch plus both suite logs and final reward artifacts, and add their verified hashes and actual command to runtime-evidence.json under verifier_image_can_launch_and_grade. Keep the current image, harness, scoring policy and budgets unchanged unless a measured defect warrants an authorized change.
